purpose: Independent next-milestone acceptance criteria prepared while v0.5 facing/settings repairs finish; no current feature-completion claim

gaps: nonfinal focused enemy death leaves BODY focus
held Enter repeat advances source selection into committed command

activation: One initial Enter/Space/pad-confirm press selects a source; holding that same physical input cannot confirm an automatically focused target.
A fresh release and intentional second press commits exactly one legal target action.
Auto-repeat cannot spend two newly rendered hand cards at the same index, buy multiple cards, confirm a new campaign, or invoke a recap action.
Text inputs keep ordinary typing behavior; activation guards must not break seed entry or local feedback text.
focusRecovery: A removed enemy, fallen source binding, spent card and terminal transition leave a meaningful visible focus target rather than BODY.
Source selection, target change and Escape cancel preserve the intended action context and create no reducer/save mutation.
Motion-on holds and reduced-motion immediate outcomes converge on accessible outcome focus without accidental late commands.
Dialog focus stays inside the actual dialog and returns to its opener or a valid replacement after closure.
controllerProbe: Exercise source/target selection, reward skip/take, shop buy/remove, upgrades, settings, cancel, pause and recap through standard-pad polling.
Test press/release latching across renders, held-button connection, disconnect, blur, visibility changes and presentation settlement.
Movement selects visible meaningful controls within current dialog/game context; no invisible background activation or save mutation from navigation.
Synthetic navigator.getGamepads injection must be labeled browser QA, never native hardware, Steam Input or Steam Deck certification.
regression: Compare exact canonical state/event outcomes and save generation for supported accepted actions against frozen v0.5 rules.
Repeat inherited defects on immutable v0.4, then verify repaired cases on final source/digest; preserve negative findings and baseline evidence.
Actual complete keyboard/pad-driven campaign or declared representative earned progression includes reload, loss/victory and explicit recovery.
limits: Successful synthetic input QA supports functionality. It does not establish human comfort, motor accessibility, all hardware mapping or enjoyable decisions.
